name: Our Weakness
overview: Scripture reveals that human weakness is deeply connected to the deceitfulness of the heart, which is described as desperately wicked and beyond human understanding (Jeremiah 17:9). Yet, God, who searches the heart and judges according to each person's deeds, responds to the cries of the righteous by delivering them from their troubles (Psalms 34:17; Jeremiah 17:10). Believers are encouraged to find joy and delight in the Lord, trusting that He will fulfill the desires of their hearts (Psalms 37:4), and to persist in prayer without losing heart, recognizing their continual need for God's strength (Luke 18:1). This dependence on God is modeled in Christ’s teaching and example (Matthew 5:1), guiding believers to embrace their weakness as an opportunity for God’s power to be made perfect.
